title: What should a parent do if their child refuses to participate in a therapy session at Pinnacle Blooms Network?
metaTitle: Handling Therapy Resistance in Children | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network expert therapists turn children's resistance to therapy into an opportunity for understanding and facilitating personalized, effective therapy
html: We understand that sometimes children can be resistant to new experiences or activities. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, our professional therapists bring a blend of patience, empathy, and creativity to encourage the child's participation. We believe in turning this challenge into an opportunity to better understand your child. Our most critical partners in this process are the parents. By collaborating, we identify the underlying reasons for this resistance and devise strategies to help the child engage and enjoy in the therapy session. Remember, every small step toward acceptance and participation is significant progress.
